name: voltron-lions
description: Single-plugin marketplace for Voltron-Lions: mission-style multi-agent orchestration with Voltron Main and four specialist Lions (Red/Blue/Green/Yellow).

plugins.name: voltron-lions
plugins.description: Turn one objective into a reviewed plan, then execute it with five parallel agents that never touch the same file. Nothing runs until you approve. Briefs, plans, and reports export as Markdown plus schema.org JSON-LD, so a directory of missions becomes a queryable history.
